import pandas as pd

# List all source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_89/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_89/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_89/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_89/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_89/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_89/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_89/training_6.csv",
]

# Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # Ensure schema matches target schema: ['air_store_id', 'dow']
    # Convert dow to integer explicitly (some CSVs might have it as float)
    df = df[['air_store_id', 'dow']].copy()
    df['dow'] = df['dow'].astype(int)
    dfs.append(df)

# Since all source tables have the exact same schema as the target,
# and the target examples show a union of all these rows,
# we concatenate (union) all source DataFrames vertically.
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# The target schema is ['air_store_id': string, 'dow': integer]
# Ensure types are correct
target_df['air_store_id'] = target_df['air_store_id'].astype(str)
target_df['dow'] = target_df['dow'].astype(int)

# Write the result to the specified path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_89/target_multisource_cot.csv"
target_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
